top_findings.title: Repair run changed nothing — all five defects named in FEEDBACK.md are still present
top_findings.evidence: TASK.md is a REPAIR TASK and FEEDBACK.md lists 'POST /books not exposed', 'GET /books/{id} not exposed', 'PUT /books/{id} not exposed', 'DELETE /books/{id} not exposed', 'No input validation'. grep -rn -E '@app\.|@router\.|APIRouter|include_router' --include='*.py' . returns exactly 2 hits: main.py:22 @app.get("/health") and main.py:26 @app.get("/books"). retort.db run 11 has _second_try=1.0, _turns=12, _duration_seconds=41.5.
top_findings.suggestion: Wire book_api.py's existing CRUD functions into main.py as FastAPI routes; the logic is already written.

top_findings.title: All 8 tests in test_book_api.py fail — every HTTP request raises before its assert
top_findings.evidence: Archived .coverage line_bits for test_book_api.py cover the request-issuing lines (18, 23-27, 37, 45-49, 64-68, 88-92, 106-110, 125) but NONE of the assert lines that immediately follow (19, 29, 38, 51, 70, 94, 112, 126). book_api.py and main.py have ZERO covered lines, so application code was never executed. Stored test_coverage=0.25 is whole-directory line coverage carried entirely by the test files.
top_findings.suggestion: Start the server via a fixture with a readiness poll (or use fastapi.testclient.TestClient) instead of a bare module-level subprocess.Popen + sleep(2).

top_findings.title: GET /books route exists but its table is never created — 500 on a fresh workspace
top_findings.evidence: main.py:26-33 SELECTs from books, but main.py:7 init_db() is defined and never called (grep init_db -> only book_api.py:143 calls book_api's own copy; no @app.on_event/lifespan anywhere). No books.db exists in the archive, so the first request raises sqlite3.OperationalError: no such table: books. The route also returns raw tuples (main.py:31-33), not JSON objects.
top_findings.suggestion: Call init_db() at startup and return dicts built from cursor.description.

top_findings.title: POST /books is not exposed by the served app
top_findings.evidence: No @app.post anywhere (grep over all *.py returns 0 hits). book_api.py:24 create_book(title, author, year, isbn) is a complete, correct implementation but main.py:1-2 imports only fastapi and sqlite3 and never imports book_api.

top_findings.title: GET /books ignores the ?author= filter
top_findings.evidence: main.py:27 'async def get_books()' takes no parameters and main.py:30 runs an unconditional 'SELECT * FROM books'. The filtering logic exists at book_api.py:42-55 (get_all_books(author=...)) but is unrouted.
top_findings.suggestion: Add an 'author: Optional[str] = None' query parameter and delegate to book_api.get_all_books.
